mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.build: arduino-cli 1.5.1, Arduino-ESP32 core 3.3.12 (its arduino-lib-builder 6671d0b on ESP-IDF v5.5.5, from the image's esp_app_desc_t)
firmware.not_committed: The images are plain Arduino builds of the sketch with the options above; they are not added to the repository.

runs.octal16: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 16 --psram-mb 8 --flash-octal --bootloader octal16.bootloader.bin --ptable octal16.partitions.bin --app octal16.bin --console uart0 --max-seconds 40 --no-dump
runs.octal32: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 32 --psram-mb 16 --flash-octal --bootloader octal32.bootloader.bin --ptable octal32.partitions.bin --app octal32.bin --console uart0 --max-seconds 40 --no-dump
runs.control: the octal16 image on the quad flash model (the same command without --flash-octal)
